title: Conan Exiles Enhanced (free for PlayStation owners) and Aloft come to PS5 in early 2027 (Funcom, PlayStation Blog)
status: scheduled in Publer 03:21Z for 05:00Z (09:00 Dubai) on Instagram, X and Threads; reel v3 (runner), clipcard with the date card on the sunset tower stretch. The v1 split posts (09:30) were moved to Publer drafts, not deleted: Publer would not swap the video on a scheduled post.

sources.who: PlayStation Blog, Jarle Hrafn Grindhaug, Communications Manager, Funcom
sources.quote: All players who own Conan Exiles on PlayStation will get the Enhanced version for PlayStation 5 for free.

sources.who: Steam 1660080 (Aloft) and 440900 (Conan Exiles Enhanced), cc=ae and sa
sources.quote: Aloft 68.49 AED / 51.49 SR; Conan Exiles Enhanced 159.99 AED / 159.99 SR; no Arabic in either

claims.claim: Both on PS5 in early 2027, no exact dates
Conan Exiles Enhanced free for owners on PlayStation; Bazaar items and DLC carry over PS4 to PS5; Isle of Siptah separate
Aloft's console debut; includes all Early Access updates and 1.0

brief.hook: Conan's horned warrior before a hut and a mountain, «ترقية مجانية لـ Conan Exiles / على PS5 في 2027»

brief.credit: لقطات من نسخة PC (PS5 footage is YouTube only)

brief.why: the first comment will ask when and how much: the caption and the pinned comment say no date or price yet, and who gets the free upgrade
